undecidable.why: two or more different opaque references

meaning: A partially resolved ARN is still comparable: two runtimes whose role strings differ outside the variable reference hold different roles whatever the variable is, and two written identically hold the same one. The shared-role rule is only blocked when a role is nothing but an opaque reference and the two runtimes carry different ones, because substitution could make them equal. The published shared-role count is a lower bound by at most the undecidable count.
